## Getting Started: Hosting & Domain

- **Hosting Provider:** The tutorial uses **Hostinger** for its affordability and features.
- **Recommended Plan:** The **Premium Shared Hosting** plan is recommended because it supports up to 100 websites, includes more storage, unlimited bandwidth, and a **free domain name** for the first year.

> [!TIP]
> Use the coupon code `Charlie Chang` at checkout for an additional discount on your hosting plan.

## Initial WordPress Setup

- **Claim Your Domain:** After purchasing hosting, the first step is to claim your free domain through the Hostinger dashboard.
- **WordPress Installation:** Use the guided setup to build a new website with **WordPress**.
- **Create Account:** You'll need to create an administrator username and password for your WordPress installation.
- **Themes:** Skip the initial theme selection during setup; you can choose a better one later from the WordPress dashboard.

## Essential WordPress Configuration

- **Plugins:**
  - Review and deactivate any pre-installed plugins you don't need.
  - Install the **Yoast SEO** plugin from the `Plugins > Add New` menu to help with search engine optimization. It's a free and powerful tool.
- **Permalinks:**
  - Navigate to `Settings` > `Permalinks`.
  - Change the structure to **Post name**. This creates clean, SEO-friendly URLs (e.g., `yourdomain.com/your-post-title`).

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Setting the permalink structure is a crucial step that many beginners miss. Complete this right after installing WordPress.

## Designing Your Website

- **Choosing a Theme:**
  - Go to `Appearance` > `Themes` > `Add New`.
  - WordPress offers thousands of free themes. Browse the 'Popular' or 'Latest' tabs to find one that fits your brand (blog, business, portfolio, etc.).
- **Page Builders:**
  - **Built-in Customizer:** Most themes come with their own drag-and-drop customizer for editing your site's appearance.
  - **Elementor:** A powerful and very popular free plugin that provides a more advanced drag-and-drop page-building experience.

## Customization & Content

- **Homepage Customization:** Use the theme's customizer to change elements like the logo, header image, text, button links, and colors. You can also delete entire sections (blocks) that you don't need.
- **Menus:** Create and manage your site's navigation menus under `Appearance` > `Menus`. Add pages like 'Home', 'Blog', or 'About' and arrange them in your primary header menu.
- **Creating New Pages:**
  - Create pages under `Pages` > `Add New`.
  - The tutorial recommends clicking `Edit with Elementor` for a more intuitive, visual building process compared to the default WordPress editor.
  - With Elementor, you drag widgets like **headings, text editors, and images** onto the page and arrange them in different column structures.

## Key Takeaway

> [!NOTE]
> Don't get stuck striving for perfection. The most important thing is to get your website live and then focus on marketing to attract visitors. A functional, published website is more valuable than a perfect but unfinished one.
